messages:
alex_support: Heads up — AcmeCorp flagged a huge delta between their dashboard and invoice for the March 31 cutoff. Dashboard shows ~120k tokens but invoice line item reads ~480k and the plan tier flipped. Can someone triage?
priya_billing: Can you drop the account id + invoice number? Also need a link to the dashboard screenshot if you have it. :eyes:
alex_support: acct: ACME-1290 / invoice: INV-2027-03-ACME-009. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/snap/INV-ACME-009.png
morgan_engineering: I can look. Quick Q: is the invoice generated from finalized ledger table or the dashboard cache? Those sometimes diverge during backfills.
priya_billing: Invoice comes from ledger.final_charges (post-run job) while the dashboard reads event_aggregates cache (near-real-time). They should match after month close but backfills can cause divergence.
elena_finance: If ledger and dashboard disagree at close, invoice (ledger) is the source of truth. But any involuntary tier bump needs manual review — this looks like a +4x multiplier, we should hold.
billing-bot: Invoice generation completed: INV-2027-03-ACME-009 at 2027-04-01T05:12:03Z.
morgan_engineering: Found candidate cause: we had an embed-reindex backfill that retried at 2027-03-31T23:58Z and again at 00:03Z with duplicate ingestion for a subset of rows. Running a quick dedupe query now.

morgan_engineering: SQL (quick repro):
```
SELECT request_id, count(*) as attempts, sum(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM ingestion.events
WHERE account_id='ACME-1290' AND event_time >= '2027-03-31' AND event_time < '2027-04-01'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

morgan_engineering: Query shows ~1,200 rows duplicated, ~360k tokens duplicated. Looks like retries with retry_id = NULL.
alex_support: That lines up with the 480k invoice vs 120k dashboard. Dashboard probably deduped on ingest_id but ledger counted the duplicate events from batch job.
elena_finance: Do we have a list of the affected ingestion jobs and whether they were marked as successful? If ledger consumed duplicates before dedupe job ran, we'll need to reverse charges or manual credit.
priya_billing: Can SRE confirm the backfill job behavior? If we can prove duplicates, we should create an adjustment before collections. Please escalate billing hold.
sre_ops: I see the embed-reindex job had a partial failure at 23:57:48 UTC due to a transient 503 from storage; the retry loop reprocessed the same batch without idempotency keys for ~22k events. Job id: job-embed-reindex-2027-03-31-2355. Logs: https://logs.redwood/jobs/job-embed-reindex-2027-03-31-2355
morgan_engineering: Proposed short-term fix: patch the ingestion consumer to ignore events with identical (request_id, event_time) within the cutoff window OR prefer the ledger ingest dedupe pass. Long-term: add idempotency keys to reindex path.
elena_finance: For the customer: can we compute an adjustment delta (invoice - expected) and issue credit if confirmed? What's the exact delta?
morgan_engineering: Based on SQL it's ~360k duplicated tokens. So invoice overcharged by ~360k token units for March 31. Need to map token units to billing units — may be 1:1 for completions, embeddings differ.
alex_support: Customer says they saw a plan tier bump (to Enterprise) on Apr 1 due to invoice total. They're on grandfathered 'ProPlus' that only flips at >100k billed tokens. If we credit 360k they drop below threshold and tier revert.
priya_billing: Action items: 1) Billing hold on INV-2027-03-ACME-009 (do not collect). 2) Create support ticket referencing job logs and SQL repro. 3) Prepare audit CSV with affected event ids for ACME. 4) Draft credit memo for ~360k tokens pending verification.
billing-bot: Billing hold requested by @priya_billing for INV-2027-03-ACME-009 — status: PENDING_APPROVAL.
priya_billing: Assigning to @elena_finance for approval and @morgan_engineering for remediation.
elena_finance: Approving provisional hold. Please attach the CSV and estimated USD impact for reconciliation.
morgan_engineering: I'll generate the dedupe script and export the affected event ids. Quick check command:
```
-- dedupe candidate export
COPY (
  SELECT event_id, request_id, tokens, event_time
  FROM ingestion.events
  WHERE account_id='ACME-1290' AND event_time >= '2027-03-31' AND event_time < '2027-04-01' AND request_id IN (
    SELECT request_id FROM ingestion.events GROUP BY request_id HAVING count(*)>1
  )
) TO STDOUT CSV HEADER;
```
alex_support: Customer asks for an ETA — can we promise a same-day fix + credit? They are pretty unhappy.
morgan_engineering: ETA for CSV + delta calc: 3 hours. ETA for patch to prevent future reindexes duplicating: ~2 days (hotfix to add idempotency).
priya_billing: I'll open an incident ticket for the customer and notify ACME CSM. Please post the CSV and USD estimate here when ready.

sre_ops: Temporary mitigation — stopped the embed-reindex schedule and marked job-embed-reindex-2027-03-31-2355 as quarantined. Also added alert to detect duplicate request_id spikes at cutoff windows. :white_check_mark:

alex_support: Thanks. I'll update the customer: we found duplicate ingestion from a reindex job, holding invoice while we verify and prepare an adjustment.
elena_finance: Once CSV + USD impact posted I will approve the credit memo and route for accounting reversal.
priya_billing: Filing support ticket: https://support.redwood/tickets/ACME-1290-INVINV-009-ESCAL. Assigning to billing ops & eng.

alex_support: Customer reply: "Appreciate the quick response — waiting on the credit to reflect before we escalate internally."
morgan_engineering: CSV uploaded: https://secure-artifacts.redwood/exports/acme-1290-march31-duplicates.csv. Delta estimate: 360,214 tokens -> ~$1,080 (approx) pending final SKU mapping.
priya_billing: Elastic note: apply provisional credit and mark invoice as amended. I'll coordinate with accounting.
elena_finance: Marking this as FINANCE-ACTIONABLE. Will follow up in accounting queue and confirm when credit posted.
priya_billing: Great. Final checklist: (1) invoice hold + provisional credit, (2) export attached, (3) remediation for reindex idempotency, (4) postmortem and customer note.
morgan_engineering: I'll create a PR for idempotency and link to the postmortem.
alex_support: Closing loop with customer now. I'll post final confirmation once credit appears. :thumbsup:
